question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘The Oath of the Vayuputras’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amish Tripathi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Amish Tripathi** is the author of the book 'The Oath of the Vayuputras'.
 
• The book is the third and final part of the Shiva Trilogy series.
 
• Amish Tripathi is a well-known Indian author famous for his mythological fiction.
